context: Judges how well a change resolves two specific review comments on a Next.js API route, without over-reaching.

checklist.name: scalar_query
checklist.description: Repeated q parameters are handled deterministically: either rejected with a 400 JSON error or reduced to a single defined value before the RPC call.

checklist.name: missing_query
checklist.description: A missing or empty q is handled explicitly (a 400 JSON error, or a documented empty result), not passed through as undefined.

checklist.name: json_error_on_failure
checklist.description: A failed searchProducts call returns a JSON body with an error field and a meaningful non-200 status (for example 502 or 503).

checklist.name: keeps_middleware
checklist.description: The route remains wrapped in InstrumentationMiddleware.

checklist.name: no_double_reporting
checklist.description: The change neither removes the existing failure recording nor records the same failure twice.

checklist.name: follows_existing_pattern
checklist.description: Failure handling logs the catalog failure through the existing logger and returns a JSON error response consistent with the API's existing error-response style.

checklist.name: replies_written
checklist.description: REVIEW_REPLIES.md contains two replies, one about repeated q handling and one about catalog failure handling, and each accurately describes the corresponding code change.

checklist.name: in_scope
checklist.description: Only the search route and, if needed, the gateway are changed; other API routes and unrelated files are untouched.
